details:
VRCSDK: 3.1.7
VPM Resolver: 0.1.15

Strong named assembly reference to Newtonsoft Json 12.0.0.0 (com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json 2.0.2, equivalent to Newtonsoft Json 12.0.301) prevents the following assemblies from being loaded when upgrading to com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json 3.0.2 (Newtonsoft Json 13.0.1):
- Packages/com.vrchat.base/Editor/VRCSDK/Dependencies/VRChat/CreatorCompanion/WatsonTcp.dll
- Packages/com.vrchat.core.vpm-resolver/Editor/Dependencies/vpm-core-lib.dll

It looks like WatsonTcp was last updated 2 months ago (4.8.14.14) and it supports Newtonsoft.Json >= 13.0.1, (currently included WatsonTcp.dll: 4.8.14.0)


5 errors thrown into console:

- [Assembly 'Library/ScriptAssemblies/VRC.SDKBase.Editor.dll' will not be loaded due to errors: Reference has errors 'WatsonTcp'.]

- [Assembly 'Library/ScriptAssemblies/com.vrchat.core.vpm-resolver.Editor.dll' will not be loaded due to errors: Reference has errors 'vpm-core-lib'.]

- [Assembly 'Library/ScriptAssemblies/VRC.SDK3.Editor.dll' will not be loaded due to errors: Reference has errors 'VRC.SDKBase.Editor'.]

- [Assembly 'Packages/com.vrchat.base/Editor/VRCSDK/Dependencies/VRChat/CreatorCompanion/WatsonTcp.dll' will not be loaded due to errors: WatsonTcp references strong named Newtonsoft.Json Assembly references: 12.0.0.0 Found in project: 13.0.0.0. Assembly Version Validation can be disabled in Player Settings "Assembly Version Validation"]

- [Assembly 'Packages/com.vrchat.core.vpm-resolver/Editor/Dependencies/vpm-core-lib.dll' will not be loaded due to errors: vpm-core-lib references strong named Newtonsoft.Json Assembly references: 12.0.0.0 Found in project: 13.0.0.0. Assembly Version Validation can be disabled in Player Settings "Assembly Version Validation"]
title: [SDK3 (3.1.7) / VPM Resolver (0.1.15)] Upgrading to com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json 3.0.2 (Newtonsoft Json 13.0.1) prevents SDK and VPM Resolver assemblies from loading
